policy: MajorMUD 1.11p native behavior is promoted only when recovered evidence supports it. Operator-mandated Reforged prompt behavior applies to Classic, Custom, and AI. Unproven native details remain evidence-gated or UNKNOWN.

dispatcher_order: preserve the entire original prompt input
resolve a registered command including valid abbreviations
recognize explicit native speech-prefix actions and evidence-backed data-driven actions
execute the resolved command/action when valid
otherwise SAY the entire original input
operator_global_rule.ambiguity: An abbreviation that does not resolve to one valid command is not a valid command and therefore falls through to SAY.
operator_global_rule.unknown_command_response: The command prompt does not emit the normal generic unknown-command response for unrecognized text.
operator_global_rule.talk_mode_note: Native help proves FAST/SLOW speech modes, but the project rule intentionally applies command-to-SAY fallback globally in all Reforged world types.

findings: the configured talk character sends text to others in the same room
the configured yell character sends text to the current room and adjacent rooms
/Username <TEXT> is a one-recipient telepath form
SAY <MESSAGE> is a native action command
GOSSIP <MESSAGE> is heard by users whose gossip flag is enabled and GOSSIP alone toggles the flag
AUCTION is described as the same channel model as GOSSIP and is primarily for trade/sale advertising
FORGET <Player> toggles ignoring that player's telepaths and FORGET alone lists ignored senders
INVITE <USERNAME> invites a player
UNINVITE <USERNAME> kicks a player from the adventuring group
JOIN <USERNAME> requires an existing invite
LEAVE exits the adventuring group
PARTY displays the group
BACKRANK and FRONTRANK are native party positioning commands
FOLLOW <username> after an invitation starts following that person
a follower moves where the leader moves
LEAVE or leader UNINVITE stops following
the native help also mentions exit-from-game as a stop-following event, but exact linkdead/disconnect membership semantics are not inferred from this
JOIN <n> selects a broadcast group
JOIN <username> joins an invited party
JOIN GANG <gangname> joins an invited gang
the decoded help states broadcast groups 1 through 126 and JOIN 0 for the default group
LEAVE while following leaves the party
LEAVE while not in a party resets the broadcast group to group 0
LEAVE GANG leaves a gang
SET TELEPATH ON/OFF exists, but the compact wording does not prove the blocking polarity safely enough for this pass
SET FOLLOW BLIND/NORMAL is native
SET SPEECH FAST/SLOW is native and FAST says otherwise-unrecognized command/action text to the room

gossip_setting.finding: SET GOSSIP ON/OFF and no-argument toggle behavior are directly described.

auction_setting.finding: SET AUCTION ON/OFF and no-argument toggle behavior are directly described.

findings: SHARE <amount> <currency> [WITH <ROOM/PARTY>] is the native syntax
PARTY is assumed when WITH ROOM or WITH PARTY is omitted
the requested amount is divided evenly among eligible recipients using whole currency units and the sender retains the remainder
the sender is not counted as a recipient
hidden recipients are excluded
recipients whose RECEIVE setting is off are excluded
share.runtime_boundary: Core recipient selection, integer distribution, remainder retention, and exact-denomination preservation are implemented. Exact native validation ordering and success/failure prose remain unresolved.

findings: SET FOLLOW BLIND and SET FOLLOW NORMAL are native
BLIND suppresses room descriptions while moving with the party
NORMAL shows room descriptions normally while moving with the party
follow_mode.runtime_boundary: The proven room-description distinction is live. Exact default mode and any additional message suppression outside room descriptions remain unresolved.

findings: BROADCAST <text> sends to the selected broadcast group
BR is an explicitly documented alias for BROADCAST
the apostrophe prefix can act as a broadcast shortcut when that global command character is available
BROADGANG has the explicit BG alias
message 123 says broadcast groups 1 through 127, while JOIN help message 157 says 1 through 126; the exact upper bound remains evidence-conflicted
broadcasting.runtime_boundary: BR command resolution is corrected. Broadcast-group state and apostrophe-shortcut ownership remain gated because channel state/global-command-character ownership are not complete.

native_support.finding: Native support records preserve dedicated talk/yell character identities; decoded WCCMMHLP identifies the actual configured examples used by the Classic command help.

command_table_audit.abbreviation_policy: Newly recovered names that do not yet have exact minimum-prefix evidence are registered only at their full-name length. Existing historical aliases remain under commands.native-player-command-table UNKNOWN until exact native alias/precedence evidence is recovered.
command_table_audit.tell: No native TELL command identity was promoted. The recovered one-recipient native form is /Username <TEXT>; an unrecognized 'tell ...' prompt therefore follows the global SAY fallback until contrary native evidence is recovered.
command_table_audit.whisper: A native ABI identity for _cmd_whisper exists, but exact syntax, range, targeting and rendering are not recovered; WHISPER remains UNKNOWN and is not fabricated.
command_table_audit.share: SHARE is no longer an identity-only evidence gate: WCCMMHLP message 227 proves its core PARTY/ROOM distribution semantics. Exact minimum abbreviation, validation ordering, and messages remain unresolved.
command_table_audit.proven_alias_correction: WCCMMHLP message 123 explicitly proves BR = BROADCAST. BR was removed from BRIEF and assigned to BROADCAST. BACKSTAB=BS and BROADGANG=BG remain explicit native aliases from help.
command_table_audit.ambiguity_resolution: The dispatcher only executes a command after one valid catalog resolution. Ambiguous or otherwise unresolved prompt tokens fall through to SAY under the global Reforged rule; exact native precedence among unresolved legacy prefixes remains UNKNOWN.

strong: YELL reaches the source room plus rooms directly adjacent through exits
GOSSIP and AUCTION are same-world global channels filtered by their receive flags
FORGET toggles a per-sender telepath block
not_promoted: language, color, invisibility, moderation and logging effects
SET MESSAGES LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH per-message priority membership
SET ENTRANCES default state and exact entry/exit filtering

implemented_from_evidence: TRACK <user> is the separate tracking-skill action and requires the Track skill
LEAVE exits an ordinary non-leader party membership
JOIN GANG and LEAVE GANG continue to route to gang handling
JOIN <username> accepts an invitation and immediately starts following that leader
FOLLOW <username> also accepts/uses an invitation and starts following that leader
BACKRANK is rejected when it would make Backrank outnumber Frontrank, matching the native front>=back rule
SET FOLLOW BLIND suppresses room descriptions while party-follow movement is occurring; SET FOLLOW NORMAL restores normal room descriptions
an explicitly resolved follower QUIT stops following; unexpected socket loss/linkdead behavior remains untouched and UNKNOWN
explicitly_not_guessed: automatic successor selection when a multi-member leader leaves
XP, loot, quest-credit, assist, spell, teleport or resurrection sharing
exact Frontrank spot/slot formula beyond the proven front>=back balance rule
leader rank-change behavior and initial/default party-rank assignment beyond the compatibility representation
party_runtime_boundary.broadcast_group_gap: JOIN <n> and LEAVE-to-group-0 are proven native command semantics, but broadcast-group runtime state is not evidence-complete in this pass and remains gated.
party_runtime_boundary.generic_multiplayer_shell_exclusion: RuntimeMultiplayerCompletionState is a non-authoritative generic Reforged smoke model. Its equal XP split, invite-expiry, leader-succession, corpse, disconnect, and persistence choices do not feed the Classic live party path and earn no MajorMUD parity credit.
party_runtime_boundary.party_xp_loot_assist_audit: Classic party XP/loot sharing remains unresolved; the retained PROG-0103 XP-party probe explicitly says the rule is unresolved. ASSIST remains a separate STRONG combat runtime pending native party/assist admission and threat proof. No party loot/XP sharing rule is promoted in Pass 19.
party_runtime_boundary.party_spell_target_audit: The existing spell target-type 13 party projection remains owned by the prior spell runtime/evidence work; Pass 19 does not promote its exact party targeting semantics. Exact party spell/teleport/resurrection sharing remains UNKNOWN in the party assertion.

transport_correction.native_shape: source room + recognized command + payment gate + immediate destination move

parity_delta.promotion: native.communications.classic-range-rendering moved UNKNOWN -> STRONG because native help/support evidence now establishes the core channel/range semantics without claiming exact rendering.

implemented_from_message_227: optional WITH ROOM / WITH PARTY selector
whole-unit integer division across eligible recipients
one atomic multi-character save transaction for the distribution
named denomination is preserved rather than silently converted to another denomination
still_unknown: exact native minimum abbreviation for SHARE
exact insufficient-funds validation order and failure text
exact no-recipient and amount-smaller-than-recipient-count behavior text

proven: SET GOSSIP ON/OFF and SET AUCTION ON/OFF control receipt of those global channels
SET MESSAGES LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH is native and controls high/medium/low priority message receipt
SET ENTRANCES ON/OFF is native and controls realm entrance/exit notices
SET FOLLOW BLIND/NORMAL is native and controls party-follow room-description output
gated: the exhaustive native message-priority classification behind SET MESSAGES
exact defaults/persistence for SET MESSAGES and SET ENTRANCES
any SQUELCH command or behavior not proven by retained native evidence

help_audit.runtime_authority: RuntimeMajorMudNativeHelpCatalog loads decoded WCCMMHLP bodies verbatim and resolves only native main-menu aliases or a single exact title-token match.
help_audit.classic_fail_closed: If retained native evidence does not resolve exactly one HELP topic, Classic no longer falls through to synthetic Reforged command help.
help_audit.known_ambiguity_example: FOLLOW occurs in multiple decoded native title records (SET-related and party-follow topics), so exact native fuzzy/prefix precedence remains UNKNOWN rather than being guessed.
help_audit.known_unique_example: SHARE is a unique decoded title-token and resolves to native WCCMMHLP body 227.
help_audit.custom_ai_boundary: Custom/AI may use Reforged synthetic command help after native help does not resolve; this is an extension and not Classic parity evidence.
